tool_result_content:
usage: apply-spec-transition.py [-h]
                                {bootstrap,init,add-category,apply,chunk,aggregate,set-targets,set-foundation,set-decision,set-knowledge-candidate,set-qa-source,set-qa-design-applications,fix-qa-knowledge-ref}
                                ...

spec-state.json 単一 transition writer (run-system-spec-elicit)

positional arguments:
  {bootstrap,init,add-category,apply,chunk,aggregate,set-targets,set-foundation,set-decision,set-knowledge-candidate,set-qa-source,set-qa-design-applications,fix-qa-knowledge-ref}
    bootstrap           R0 用の空 state envelope を生成
    init                taxonomy からマトリクスを初期化
    add-category        taxonomy に無いカテゴリ行を 1 件足す
    apply               単一セル op を適用
    chunk               ターン列を 1 invocation ぶん適用
    aggregate           集約状態を再計算
    set-targets         取得対象一覧 targets[] を設定
    set-foundation      requirements_foundation (上位概念 U1-U9) を設定/確定
    set-decision        意思決定支援 record を upsert
    set-knowledge-candidate
                        seed 外 knowledge candidate を lifecycle 付きで upsert
    set-qa-source       既存 qa の質問・回答を保ったまま欠落した出所メタデータだけを追記
    set-qa-design-applications
                        既存 qa の質問・回答を保ったまま設計適用を追記
    fix-qa-knowledge-ref
                        解釈本文を変えず、実在しない knowledge_ref だけを実在する参照へ差し替え

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
